newsitem.title: USA: CME October cattle expire higher, hogs lower.
newsitem.headline: CME October cattle expire higher, hogs lower.

text.p: CME October live cattle was actively traded in the 10 minutes ahead of its expiration at 1200 CDT, with some estimating about 900 contracts traded in that period, traders said.
October cattle closed up 0.225 cent at 73.00 cents per lb.
October hogs expired down 0.225 at 54.900, but trading was orderly through the close.

October cattle started the day with 3,110 open interest and preliminary figures show 2,700 contracts traded Thursday. In October hogs, 394 contracts traded Thursday, down from 593 at the start of the session.
